This page is an alphabetical list of all the restaurants and chains visited for the ''Doughboys'' and ''Doughboys Double'' podcast. 

Also includes the frozen foods they rated during '''Topical Freeze''', the grocery stores from '''Friendly Green Grocer Mitch's Grocery Store Month''', the Coca-Cola Freestyle Machine, Good Humor, and the fruits/vegetables of '''Garden of Eatin''''.

Other pages of navigation: [[Episodes|Main Episodes List]] and a [[Guest List]].
